title: Curation Workbench: publishable performance-metadata and guided version pins
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a 'Curation Workbench' view in the Console where platform users can onboard a new model version, review a publishable performance-metadata package (latency/cost/quality profiles), and get a guided recommendation to pin a version to a route. The workbench combines automated heuristics (SLO fit, cost delta, regression risk) with manual controls: pin preview sandbox, temporal snapshots, and an explicit Publish Performance Profile button that gates downstream rollouts. Goal: reduce time-to-pin and reduce accidental regressions when teams switch model versions.
acceptance_criteria: Workbench view accessible from model catalog -> version -> 'Open Curation Workbench'
Performance metadata card renders 90th/95th latency, median cost-per-1k tokens, and quality deltas vs pinned version
Suggested pin recommendation shows reason, expected cost delta, and SLO risk as a single-line rationale
Publish Performance Profile action creates an immutable profile artifact and appears in model version history
Pin preview sandbox allows routing 5% traffic to candidate version and collects a 24-hour sample
Audit log entry generated for publish and pin actions (user, timestamp, diff)
E2E tests for publish flow and pin preview exist and pass in CI
notes_engineering: Prefer server-side computation of percentile latencies (pre-aggregated metrics) to avoid client slowness when opening workbench
Pin-preview routing will reuse existing feature flagging service; need small extension for temporal traffic slices
Publishable profile should be an immutable JSON blob stored in model metadata store with versioned key
Add backend validation to ensure published profile includes at least one evaluation test (regression/quality hash)
rollout_plan: Phase 1: soft-launch to internal teams + two pilot customers (3-4 weeks). Phase 2: expose to self-serve projects with opt-in guardrails (slo-aware defaults). Phase 3: auto-suggest onboarding checks as default for new accounts.
qa_tests: Smoke: open workbench for model with >3 versions
Publish: create performance profile and confirm immutable artifact in metadata store
Pin preview: route 5% traffic and validate sample metrics collected
Audit: confirm audit log event contains user, action, diff
risks: Users may over-trust the automated recommendation leading to pins that increase cost beyond budget
Sampling during pin preview may misrepresent tail latency under certain production loads
Immutable publish artifacts increase storage costs if unbounded - need retention policy
mitigations: Expose cost delta and a 'risk score' prominently; require explicit confirmation for >15% cost increase
Limit pin-preview sampling window and tie recommendations to traffic-profile similarity heuristics
Retention: auto-archive profiles older than 12 months unless explicitly pinned in release history
